contexts.text: Hence is the origin of all things on the Earth.
The origin of truth is thence.
The signification of the rising and setting of the sun.
The sun rose upon him () = conjunction of goods. AC 4312.
Zarah means the rising, and it is attributed to the sun and the first appearing of its light... So good first rises and gives light.
The Lord as a Sun is always in His rising.
The Sun of Heaven... is also said to rise, but in the heart when man is being regenerated, and also when he is in the good of love and of faith... Yet the Lord is constantly in the rising...
If the sun have risen upon him () = if he should see it clearly from what is interior. Explained.
Towards the east (or rising) () = against goods.
Hence the rising of the sun = the good of love from the Lord in clear perception.
A new rising of the revelation of Divine truth. Signified, Explained.
So far the Lord is said to arise with them.
The dayspring from on high () = Jehovah, or the Lord from eternity.
Their origin attributed to the sun.
Written on the origin of plants and animals.
All animals... derive their origin from the Spiritual in the ultimate degree... man alone from all the degrees...
The sun said to rise and set. Explained.
An Angel ascending from the rising of the sun () = the Lord providing... For, from the rising of the sun, or from the east, = from the Divine love... (See AE 422.)
The rising of the sun () = the beginning of the New Church from the Lord; the like as by morning.
The rise of the Mohammedan religion.
The origin of worldly things...
This contrition arises from fear...
From such things arise...
How representations arise.
On those who think there is an origin for all things; thus that God is not eternal.
The rising = where good is in clearness.
The rising of the sun = the good of love, which is the good of life.
The rising of the sun = those within the Church, because they have the Word, in which the Lord is always present, and thus in the rising.
The rising of the sun = the state of the Church hen in light.
The reason the rising of the sun = the Lord's Divine love, is that... where the Lord appears as a Sun, is the east, and, as He is constantly there. He is constantly in the rising.
From the rising and from the setting = all who are in the goods and truths of Heaven and the Church. Illustrated.
The brightness of His rising () = Divine truth from Divine good whence is intelligence.
Changes originating by influx... Signified.
Under East, see this reference.
Originating from correspondences.
The rising of the sun = where the Lord is; thus from the rising of the sun = from the Lord.
Originating from the Lord's love.
Adulteries originating from...
Infirmity originating from abuse...
The rising, or east = the good of love; hence a bird called from the east () = the truth of the Word, which is from the good of love.

As God is uncreate... life itself, which is God... is devoid of an origin; and that which is devoid of an origin is from eternity, and is eternal. But an idea without an origin is impossible with the natural man... but is possible with the spiritual. Explained.

Then is the morning, or rising, of the Church.
